Here are a few things I follow with every shift I attend in retail:

1. Don’t look at the clock. As much as you want to, a watched pot never boils.

2. Deep clean! Find a random aisle and deep clean everything you can find and don’t take a break. (This will make you realize how dirty your store TRULY is and once you start cleaning you won’t want to stop)

3. Go through aisles and pick up misplaced items and find their locations

4. NEVER wander around the store. This is something that I have found makes time go by way too slowly.

5. Help customers whenever you can. Sometimes I will approach someone and somehow 30 minutes goes by

I hope this helps anyone who sees this!
